title: Phenol-Chloroform Extraction and Ethanol Precipitation of RNA
author: Tomasz Suchan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rzvd766

steps.title: Adjust Reaction Volume
steps.instruction: Adjust the reaction volume to 180 μl and add salt for precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Add 160 μl nuclease-free water to reach a total volume of 180 μl.
Add 20 μl of 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2) or 20 μl of 5 M ammonium acetate (1/10 of the total volume).

steps.title: Perform Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract RNA using a phenol/chloroform mixture.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume (200 μl) of 1:1 phenol/chloroform mixture.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 5 min.
Collect the aqueous (upper) phase and transfer it to a new tube.

steps.title: Repeat Extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat the extraction process to ensure purity.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the phenol/chloroform extraction and aqueous phase collection steps.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA using ethanol and cold incubation.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at –20°C or on dry ice for at least 30 minutes.
Collect the pellet by centrifugation at 4°C for 30 min.

steps.title: Wash and Dry RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Rinse the RNA pellet and remove residual ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the pellet with 500 μl of cold 70% ethanol.
Quick spin and collect the last drop of ethanol.

steps.title: Resuspend and Store RNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final RNA pellet and store at low temperature.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the RNA in 50 μl of 0.1 mM EDTA.
Store the RNA at –20°C or below.
